description.content: Search, upload, retrieve, and delete cat images.
Search and retrieve cat images with optional filters for breed, category, size, format, and pagination. Returns random results by default.

query.description: Comma-separated breed IDs to filter images.
Comma-separated category IDs to filter images.
Comma-separated MIME types to filter by (jpg, png, gif).
Filter to only images that have breed information.

response.name: Array of cat images matching the search criteria.

The Cat API is an open, free, read and write API all about cats. Access thousands of cat images, vote on favorites, manage collections, explore breed information, and upload your own cat images. Requires a free API key for write operations.
